description: Use when validating or generating a Design Definition File (DDF) against the ECSS-E-ST-10 Annex G document requirements definition (DRD): identify the content blocks (introduction, applicable and reference documents, terms/definitions/abbreviations, design overview, per-item design solution, budgets and margins, interface definition, design justification, open-points register, supporting annexes) that are mandatory at the current review milestone (SRR, PDR, CDR, AR), classify each block as present or missing, verify its reported maturity (draft, consolidated, final) meets the milestone's minimum, and confirm the open-points register carries zero unresolved TBD/TBC items by acceptance review.
